tool.name: interview_insights
tool.description: Researches how a company interviews for a position: stages, typical questions and tasks, what interviewers look for and how to prepare, from candidate and insider reports first, then the company's own information, then less trusted sources and the agent's assumptions, as separate sections. Worth calling when someone prepares for an interview at a named company for a named role; not for general career advice or salary data. Searches the web only; takes minutes.

value.description: the company that interviews, e.g. Wise
the position interviewed for, e.g. Senior Java Engineer
optional: the one interview stage to cover, e.g. system design; without this item every stage is covered
